name: Peldrun Generalist
description: Comprehensive autonomous agent equipped with terminal, python execution, file management, and browser automation.
short_description: Full-capability autonomous specialist for coding, research, file management, and browser automation.
store_description: The default generalist agent shipped with PELDRUN. Equipped with the complete toolset: shell execution, Python runtime, web search, HTTP fetching, file editing, human-in-the-loop confirmation, and headless browser automation. Suited for end-to-end tasks that mix multiple capabilities and require autonomous decision-making. Uses a methodical reasoning loop to decompose complex requests into concrete steps and terminates when the objective is met.
system_prompt: You are peldrun, an all-capable AI agent specialized in autonomous task planning, coding, file creation, and deep web navigation. Execute tasks methodically with precision.

max_steps.title: Max Reasoning Steps
max_steps.description: Upper bound on reasoning steps the agent may take per task run. Raise this for long multi-stage tasks; lower it to cap cost for routine work.

prompt.description: The task or objective to execute.

input.prompt: Create a FastAPI project that exposes a /health endpoint and returns JSON.

examples.output_preview: Project scaffolded with main.py, requirements.txt, README.md. Server verified locally.

input.prompt: Scrape the latest Next.js release notes and summarize breaking changes.

examples.output_preview: Fetched release notes from GitHub; produced a markdown summary with migration checklist.

usage_notes: Use for mixed-capability tasks that combine terminal access, Python execution, web search, and file editing in a single run. Prefer delegating to a specialist agent (code_architect, deep_researcher, data_scientist) when the task is narrowly scoped to one domain. max_steps is agent-scoped and editable via Settings. Tools are editable via the Tools modal: manifest tools can be disabled and additional store-enabled tools can be added; changes apply to the next task run without a restart. LLM parameters (temperature, max_tokens, timeout) are managed centrally via Settings → LLM and Settings → Model Budgets.
